verdict.rationale: Fenwick's employment practice page explicitly documents counseling and litigation on trade secret misappropriation, plus protecting trade secrets and confidential business information. That covers the trade-secret litigation and confidentiality-protection parts of the story, and the story is satisfied by any one of its listed work types. The evidence is a single first-party listing with no detail on matters handled. Missing for 10: explicit employee-mobility dispute work, depth on confidentiality-program design, representative trade-secret matters or rankings, independent corroboration.
